description: 여수광양항만공사_국가별 컨테이너 물동량 통계_GW [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 여수광양항만공사. 이 데이터는 항만 및 물류정책 수립 시 국가별 컨테이너 교역 규모를 평가하고, 특정 국가에 대한 수입·수출 편중 현황을 분석하는 데 활용될 수 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 여수광양항만공사. Its tags are 광양항화물통계, 국가별 컨테이너, 수입 TEU, 수출 TEU, 환적물동량. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-06-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
